title: IJFW Settings
description: User preferences only. Decisions as enum strings; all runtime-state lives in state.json.
$comment: profile block is OPTIONAL: pre-1.6 settings files predate it and resolveProfileSettings() backfills defaults on read.

auto_update.description: Action policy for ijfw update. 'ask' prompts; 'on' allows auto (1.1.7+); 'off' suppresses.

auto_update_consent_version.description: Semver of last consent prompt. Null means never asked. Re-prompt when scheme changes.

profile.description: Profile-bus (cross-system style learning) consent + control. capture stays local always; inject gates whether the learned brief is added to prompts.

capture.description: Whether per-message style metadata is captured locally. Default 'on' (local, low-sensitivity, never raw text).

inject.description: Whether the learned low-sensitivity style brief is injected into prompts. 'on' injects; 'off' never injects; 'ask' (default) prompts once then defaults to not-injecting until enabled.

share_sensitive.description: Whether medium/high-sensitivity prefs may leave to allowlisted hosts. Default false. Toggling on writes the per-host allowlist.

inject_consent_version.description: Semver of the last injection-consent prompt shown. Null means never asked. Mirrors auto_update_consent_version.
